 [Highlight start] **Cheers Restore** is an over-the-counter dietary supplement marketed as an after-alcohol aid designed to support liver function and reduce next-day hangover symptoms [Highlight end] . It does not prevent intoxication or cure/treat medical conditions, and its statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXKcFu8qMJ8J0W3KreJYdO450pJiFyUtnRuGwAunKW539DrOzgZ0JhgCHVxVxVqngYVY113HVZ1Fgu5MXAJHliyrATcMHndB0KiOPYRiPIlqqzov7Iv71j6IuG5Ie2WXA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF13wXmfEngJa9vJiG1mSWWmT-_CLdio7n7gv3hvYsqFY-Zj42ZvdaTb9m38I22_PzwiQFiJ4z7yYBljJOiJ7_osFcjsbmLCtvIlwyQAdc1fqzEXIptIgIda4qrxtmt4uEs5kYfGuYuY3Ck0YmyRiXwmziyWbk-LmGBNfwxf6hrJb8sPR9XCPledE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXcURP9VAhnlG0-cmrkZQcS1JUIhN2ZqeuN13XHgiysAGyganKMj__dA0cZe1xtBsn5GsKvHdnofA_m2ePEY-lMTZ_XlDMGCPyafVgvQgaCJrPKxWOyqbZ9TIQeT1xdfxn1_9kKMq10TLO41Q)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXveRnzgs5en_6sX1NTmHR-gMk7CeKeHe7YzuMy2udaZyyuko9bbjcU01LxsLL_fpAu67nd3zAUfdmV5UB9tfcPccCT71LSthPAG6uhnp2b8SUn4h85c-zTlilFf-D)

### Key Ingredients & How It Works

- **Dihydromyricetin (DHM):** Derived from vine tea (typically 1,200 mg vine tea / over 1,000 mg DHM per serving) to support liver function and help reduce GABA rebound.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF13wXmfEngJa9vJiG1mSWWmT-_CLdio7n7gv3hvYsqFY-Zj42ZvdaTb9m38I22_PzwiQFiJ4z7yYBljJOiJ7_osFcjsbmLCtvIlwyQAdc1fqzEXIptIgIda4qrxtmt4uEs5kYfGuYuY3Ck0YmyRiXwmziyWbk-LmGBNfwxf6hrJb8sPR9XCPledE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXKcFu8qMJ8J0W3KreJYdO450pJiFyUtnRuGwAunKW539DrOzgZ0JhgCHVxVxVqngYVY113HVZ1Fgu5MXAJHliyrATcMHndB0KiOPYRiPIlqqzov7Iv71j6IuG5Ie2WXA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXveRnzgs5en_6sX1NTmHR-gMk7CeKeHe7YzuMy2udaZyyuko9bbjcU01LxsLL_fpAu67nd3zAUfdmV5UB9tfcPccCT71LSthPAG6uhnp2b8SUn4h85c-zTlilFf-D)
- **L-Cysteine:** Included (typically 450 mg per serving) to help address alcohol-induced acetaldehyde toxicity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-xPdZfci82hBsKx6vNA9KGpiw46SXCTIXfFJvFrUTbXEgJXepC5T_fU1z4sphojCc2QVjx6MVl6ozXaZ2pD1ToegvmnK--3g6dZC1ej9zRwEV9wuhHSeF0lXozIPKhNo1mWHMh8v6ytoI_V7JCosH8VLMp_LL5XQp-LLxPjV1D0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF13wXmfEngJa9vJiG1mSWWmT-_CLdio7n7gv3hvYsqFY-Zj42ZvdaTb9m38I22_PzwiQFiJ4z7yYBljJOiJ7_osFcjsbmLCtvIlwyQAdc1fqzEXIptIgIda4qrxtmt4uEs5kYfGuYuY3Ck0YmyRiXwmziyWbk-LmGBNfwxf6hrJb8sPR9XCPledE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXveRnzgs5en_6sX1NTmHR-gMk7CeKeHe7YzuMy2udaZyyuko9bbjcU01LxsLL_fpAu67nd3zAUfdmV5UB9tfcPccCT71LSthPAG6uhnp2b8SUn4h85c-zTlilFf-D)

### Usage & Pricing

- **How to take:** Typically 3 capsules taken after your last drink or before bed while alcohol is still in your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXKcFu8qMJ8J0W3KreJYdO450pJiFyUtnRuGwAunKW539DrOzgZ0JhgCHVxVxVqngYVY113HVZ1Fgu5MXAJHliyrATcMHndB0KiOPYRiPIlqqzov7Iv71j6IuG5Ie2WXA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXveRnzgs5en_6sX1NTmHR-gMk7CeKeHe7YzuMy2udaZyyuko9bbjcU01LxsLL_fpAu67nd3zAUfdmV5UB9tfcPccCT71LSthPAG6uhnp2b8SUn4h85c-zTlilFf-D)
- **Where to buy & cost:** Available directly from [Cheers Restore](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXKcFu8qMJ8J0W3KreJYdO450pJiFyUtnRuGwAunKW539DrOzgZ0JhgCHVxVxVqngYVY113HVZ1Fgu5MXAJHliyrATcMHndB0KiOPYRiPIlqqzov7Iv71j6IuG5Ie2WXA) (around $24–$28 for 12 doses/36 capsules, with subscription options available), as well as retailers like [Walgreens](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1yARix01Sqa6Yb0aKDqg4jXK1TIFWBuwoO799Ns2H-jzAti7HO2Q3h8EfQKTmelXF2aEi1uTx1_JxAYgAnDaY5iqgYmZON9frrRRX8h1rPbjY25A6Qmbd8GEQj1PkQrT8brYFn_USxpcY5Ztt0L_NDygvlYTRWz9Kvelaof0gwgbvpIoP2_lwpxTkMlI9Q) (around $12.99 for a 3-dose pack), [CVS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXcURP9VAhnlG0-cmrkZQcS1JUIhN2ZqeuN13XHgiysAGyganKMj__dA0cZe1xtBsn5GsKvHdnofA_m2ePEY-lMTZ_XlDMGCPyafVgvQgaCJrPKxWOyqbZ9TIQeT1xdfxn1_9kKMq10TLO41Q) , and [Sam's Club](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXpHDRERt77vCQ66bPiHTo9s66mg8KRqQbOpQ3QIsfvQamJGiStOOqawENMK6TM23gLfLFSJVsnlK7l1ZAEXbzg0YrehZNthjYTCCip0llHGa_NZGKn-gRotkQTqsT3deKO8N9uWFoo25rIw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXKcFu8qMJ8J0W3KreJYdO450pJiFyUtnRuGwAunKW539DrOzgZ0JhgCHVxVxVqngYVY113HVZ1Fgu5MXAJHliyrATcMHndB0KiOPYRiPIlqqzov7Iv71j6IuG5Ie2WXA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1yARix01Sqa6Yb0aKDqg4jXK1TIFWBuwoO799Ns2H-jzAti7HO2Q3h8EfQKTmelXF2aEi1uTx1_JxAYgAnDaY5iqgYmZON9frrRRX8h1rPbjY25A6Qmbd8GEQj1PkQrT8brYFn_USxpcY5Ztt0L_NDygvlYTRWz9Kvelaof0gwgbvpIoP2_lwpxTkMlI9Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXcURP9VAhnlG0-cmrkZQcS1JUIhN2ZqeuN13XHgiysAGyganKMj__dA0cZe1xtBsn5GsKvHdnofA_m2ePEY-lMTZ_XlDMGCPyafVgvQgaCJrPKxWOyqbZ9TIQeT1xdfxn1_9kKMq10TLO41Q)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXpHDRERt77vCQ66bPiHTo9s66mg8KRqQbOpQ3QIsfvQamJGiStOOqawENMK6TM23gLfLFSJVsnlK7l1ZAEXbzg0YrehZNthjYTCCip0llHGa_NZGKn-gRotkQTqsT3deKO8N9uWFoo25rIw)

### User Feedback & Safety Notes

- Customer reviews on retail sites often note milder next-day symptoms and better sleep, though experiences vary and some note it lessens rather than completely eliminates hangovers. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1yd6zG860JnJMONijR9w3LFWPNimhdpMllUGUab1YNZA4pgdRIPjXvFJJuyf1Ztw8IiH1tMttxfRr8A4t9630DzR6z1dZtmtgczhna9miP-CWDThLYKMCLe87vgKmxSAQPcObgR4nkgsbIeQ-z9rsIHuWhpBE-7se7l4HlrZKmHc2eM7IPV2g_awGpFGrIY) agree that DHM supplements are widely available and commonly dosed at multiple capsules depending on how much alcohol is consumed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXpHDRERt77vCQ66bPiHTo9s66mg8KRqQbOpQ3QIsfvQamJGiStOOqawENMK6TM23gLfLFSJVsnlK7l1ZAEXbzg0YrehZNthjYTCCip0llHGa_NZGKn-gRotkQTqsT3deKO8N9uWFoo25rIw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1yd6zG860JnJMONijR9w3LFWPNimhdpMllUGUab1YNZA4pgdRIPjXvFJJuyf1Ztw8IiH1tMttxfRr8A4t9630DzR6z1dZtmtgczhna9miP-CWDThLYKMCLe87vgKmxSAQPcObgR4nkgsbIeQ-z9rsIHuWhpBE-7se7l4HlrZKmHc2eM7IPV2g_awGpFGrIY)
- Consult a doctor before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medications, have a medical condition, or are sensitive to any ingredients.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXcURP9VAhnlG0-cmrkZQcS1JUIhN2ZqeuN13XHgiysAGyganKMj__dA0cZe1xtBsn5GsKvHdnofA_m2ePEY-lMTZ_XlDMGCPyafVgvQgaCJrPKxWOyqbZ9TIQeT1xdfxn1_9kKMq10TLO41Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF13wXmfEngJa9vJiG1mSWWmT-_CLdio7n7gv3hvYsqFY-Zj42ZvdaTb9m38I22_PzwiQFiJ4z7yYBljJOiJ7_osFcjsbmLCtvIlwyQAdc1fqzEXIptIgIda4qrxtmt4uEs5kYfGuYuY3Ck0YmyRiXwmziyWbk-LmGBNfwxf6hrJb8sPR9XCPledE)
